assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles are the enabling delivery chemistry that turned siRNA and mRNA from fragile molecules into usable medicines. Control of lipid pKa, self-assembly and endosomal release is exactly the molecular design principle that changed what clinicians can do, with the clearest lasting impact on patients and on biomaterials and nanomedicine broadly.
assessment.attribution: Cullis and Hope built the early lipid-nanoparticle formulation and nucleic-acid encapsulation methods; Anderson contributed combinatorial lipid discovery and optimization of ionizable lipids. Others in the list (MacLachlan, Madden, Langer) were important, and the exact division of credit between the Vancouver and Boston lineages, and between lipid design and formulation process, is unresolved.
assessment.maturity: Validated at global scale by the approved patisiran product and the mRNA vaccines, with independent confirmation across many labs. Recognition is timely, though the 2023 Medicine prize for nucleoside-modified mRNA means the committee must frame this clearly as the delivery chemistry.
uncertainties: Overlap with the 2023 Medicine prize may weigh against it
Fair allocation of credit among LNP pioneers, including MacLachlan, Madden and Langer, is uncertain
My recollection of individual contributions is from memory and not independently verified

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Targeted protein degradation by PROTACs and molecular glues introduced a new chemical modality: small molecules that rewire the ubiquitin-proteasome system to remove proteins that were previously undruggable. It is a clean example of molecular design giving precise control over recognition, with a rapidly growing pharmaceutical impact.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies conceived and demonstrated the PROTAC concept; Handa identified cereblon as the target of thalidomide, explaining molecular glue degraders. Ciulli, Gray, Sakamoto and others made major contributions, so a three-person limit forces difficult choices between the PROTAC and molecular-glue strands.
assessment.maturity: Strong independent confirmation, many compounds in advanced clinical trials, and a robust mechanistic picture. Clinical approval of a PROTAC is still pending, so some may view recognition as slightly early, but the chemical concept is established.
uncertainties: No PROTAC is yet an approved drug, which may affect perceived maturity
Compound discovery: PROTACs and molecular glues may need different recognition
Credit among Crews, Deshaies, Handa, Ciulli and Gray is contested in scope

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editing uses engineered deaminases fused to Cas proteins to make precise chemical changes to single DNA bases without double-strand cleavage. It is molecular chemical engineering of a genome, with profound consequences for biology and for therapies, and several clinical applications are underway.
assessment.attribution: Liu's laboratory is the clear intellectual origin; Komor and Gaudelli were the lead trainees on cytosine and adenine base editors respectively. A prize naming the trainees is unusual, and Liu alone could be proposed; the Kondo and Nishida deaminase-Cas9 work is an earlier related strand with unresolved priority.
assessment.maturity: Rapid, extensive independent adoption and first clinical results. The impact is already large, but long-term clinical outcomes and overlap with CRISPR (Chemistry 2020) leave some uncertainty about timing and framing.
uncertainties: Overlap in perspective with the 2020 CRISPR prize
Whether trainees would be included is doubtful; Liu alone may be the realistic configuration
Priority question regarding Nishida and Kondo

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Expanding the genetic code lets researchers install designed noncanonical amino acids at chosen sites in proteins in living cells, offering precise chemical control over protein function, labeling and biotherapeutic design. It is a general platform tool that spread across chemical biology, biomaterials and protein engineering.
assessment.attribution: Schultz established the orthogonal tRNA/synthetase strategy with Wang and others in E. coli, yeast and mammalian cells; Chin extended it to multicellular organisms and to engineered ribosomes and quadruplet codons. Mehl and Yokoyama are also credited, so allocation is plausible but needs choice.
assessment.maturity: Over two decades of independent confirmation and widespread use, with commercial and therapeutic applications (e.g. site-specific antibody conjugates). Recognition is mature.
uncertainties: Allocation among Schultz, Chin, Wang, Mehl and Yokoyama
Relative importance of the foundational concept versus later engineering extensions

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Shokat's chemical genetics of kinases and his covalent targeting of mutant KRAS G12C made a long-standing undruggable oncogene druggable, culminating in approved drugs. The work shows how rational chemical design can change what clinicians can treat.
assessment.attribution: A single-laureate candidate with a clear decisive role in the KRAS discovery and in analog-sensitive kinase chemical genetics; downstream drug development by companies builds on this, but the primary credit is not seriously disputed.
assessment.maturity: Clinical validation through approved KRAS G12C inhibitors and broad adoption of the chemical-genetic approach. Timely and mature.
uncertainties: Single-person prize may be thought narrow
The balance between academic discovery and industrial drug optimization may be debated

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Biomolecular phase separation reframed intracellular organization as a physical-chemical phenomenon, with condensates acting as membraneless compartments. It has changed how chemists and biologists think about assembly, signaling and disease, and it connects well with polymer physics and self-assembly.
assessment.attribution: Hyman and Brangwynne demonstrated liquid-like P granules and nucleoli; Rosen provided the quantitative multivalent-interaction framework. Pappu and Mittag provided essential theoretical and biophysical contributions, so the trio selection is debatable.
assessment.maturity: Impact is large but the field is still debating the functional significance of condensates in vivo, and some claims are contested. Recognition may be premature relative to the strongest candidates.
uncertainties: Contested in vivo functional relevance of condensates
Whether this is chemistry or physiology/biophysics

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Electrical reading of single DNA and RNA molecules through nanopores created a portable, label-free sequencing and sensing technology, a chemical measurement concept with strong translational reach into diagnostics and bioanalysis.
assessment.attribution: Branton, Deamer and colleagues proposed and demonstrated the concept, Akeson achieved sequence-relevant readout with enzyme ratcheting; Bayley and Kasianowicz made key pore-engineering and early-demonstration contributions. Eligibility of some named individuals may be affected by whether they are living, which I cannot verify.
assessment.maturity: Technology is widely deployed and independently validated, yet it overlaps conceptually with sequencing recognized earlier, and the chemistry content relative to the engineering is a question.
uncertainties: Living status and eligibility of some credited individuals is uncertain to me
Chemistry versus engineering and physics content
Complex allocation among five credited people

assessment.nobel_worthiness: DNA origami demonstrates programmable bottom-up design of arbitrary nanostructures with nanometer addressability, an exemplary case of molecular design principles giving control over assembly, with applications in biosensing, drug delivery and nanofabrication.
assessment.attribution: Rothemund invented scaffolded DNA origami; Yan and Yin extended it to complex 2D/3D and programmable architectures. The foundational contributions of the late Nadrian Seeman are not on the supplied credit list, which complicates a fair configuration.
assessment.maturity: Widely confirmed and broadly used, though real-world applications remain developing and the field's maturity for a Nobel remains debatable.
uncertainties: Seeman's foundational role is not representable in the credited names
Application impact still emerging
Priority among Rothemund, Yan, Yin, Winfree and Shih
